scripts.dev: vite build --watch --mode development & vite build --config vite.config.content.ts --watch --mode development
scripts.build: vite build --mode production && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts --mode production
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/package.js chrome
scripts.package:edge: npm run build && node scripts/package.js edge
scripts.package:all: npm run build && node scripts/package.js chrome && node scripts/package.js edge
